from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, hashlib, json
root = Path.cwd()
bundle = Path('/tmp/kk-batch-report-review-RzaOBRBa')
plugin = Path('/home/sergio/.codex/plugins/cache/fr-opus55-581dd0e1-20261011/kk/0.23.0')
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args])
revision = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip()
paths = ['README.md', 'formatting.py', 'tests/test_report.py', 'app.py', 'config.py', 'stats.py']
provenance = []
for role, selector in [('candidate', ':'), ('historical', revision + ':')]:
    for relative in paths:
        data = git('show', selector + relative)
        target = bundle / role / relative
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_bytes(data)
        target.chmod(0o444)
        provenance.append(dict(role=role, repository=str(root), revision=revision if role=='historical' else 'index snapshot against '+revision, original_path=relative, materialized_path=str(target), blob=git('rev-parse', selector + relative).decode().strip(), sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), line_span=[1,len(data.splitlines())], omitted_or_redacted='none'))
patch = bundle/'staged.patch'
patch.write_bytes(git('diff','--cached','--no-ext-diff'))
patch.chmod(0o444)
criteria = [str(plugin/'skills/review-code'/p) for p in ['functional-review.md','shared-change-context.md','shared-review-scope-protocol.md','shared-capy-knowledge-protocol.md']] + [str(plugin/'profiles/python/review-code'/p) for p in ['security-checklist.md','solid-checklist.md','code-quality-checklist.md','removal-plan.md']]
assert len(set(criteria)) == 8 and all(Path(p).is_file() for p in criteria)
context = bundle/'context.md'
context.write_text('''# Change context
User requests isolated code review of staged batch-report label change; review only.
Authority: repository README.md explicitly says change plain report label Items to Records, preserve count and all calculation behavior. The shipped entry point uses checked-in DETAILED_REPORT. Detailed reporting is an existing optional path and is not activated or redesigned in this increment. Historical installations/settings are not recorded.
Scope: git diff --cached, exactly formatting.py and tests/test_report.py, 3 additions and 3 deletions. No unstaged changes observed. Candidate snapshots copied from index; provenance.json records every blob. Review base: '''+revision+'''. No separate release/deployed baseline is named; do not equate HEAD with deployment.
Affected source: report() in app.py calls summarize(values, detailed=DETAILED_REPORT), then format_count(result[\"count\"]); checked-in config.py has DETAILED_REPORT=False. Unchanged stats.py implements count and optional mean. Inspect actual source and challenge these facts.
Task Scope: No task scope available — review the diff on its own merits without assuming any feature-level design doc. No related feature task documents found.
Evidence: parent executed python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v against worktree matching index: 3 tests passed (empty plain, populated plain, populated detailed mean). This is attributed parent execution, not reviewer execution.
Known coverage boundary: deployed/historical installation state not supplied or requested. Compare this increment to HEAD and assess the checked-in shipped configuration. Do not infer deployment facts.
Knowledge: parent searched kk:review-findings and kk:lang-idioms; both returned empty knowledge base.
Rejected approaches: none.
Reviewer outcomes: PAL codereview/listmodels tools unavailable in this session; independent code-reviewer is the only available isolated review path. Do not claim corroboration.
''')
manifest = {'instructions':criteria, 'diff':str(patch), 'candidate_source':[str(bundle/'candidate'/p) for p in paths if p"'!='"'README.md'], 'historical_source':[str(bundle/'historical'/p) for p in paths], 'provenance':str(bundle/'provenance.json'), 'intent_context':[str(context),str(bundle/'candidate/README.md')], 'selector':'git diff --cached', 'review_base':revision}
(bundle/'provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(provenance,indent=2)+'\\n')
(bundle/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\\n')
for target in [context,bundle/'provenance.json',bundle/'manifest.json']:
    target.chmod(0o444)
print(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2))
